content.title: Toluca: Marcel Ruiz is called up for the match against LA Galaxy
content.text: MEXICO CITY, MEXICO - AUGUST 23: Marcel Ruiz of Toluca during the match of the 6th round of the Apertura 2025 Tournament of Liga BBVA MX at the Estadio Olimpico Universitario on August 23, 2025, in Mexico City, Mexico. (Photo: Mauricio Salas/JAM MEDIA)The midfielder of Toluca's Red Devils will travel with the team to Los Angeles for the crucial second leg against LA Galaxy in the Concacaf Champions CupToluca received a boost of energy with the news that Marcel Ruiz will join the team on their trip to Los Angeles to face LA Galaxy in the Concacaf Champions Cup. Although his participation in the match is not yet guaranteed, his presence marks an important step in his recovery. The midfielder has shown significant progress in his knee rehabilitation, allowing him to partially rejoin training sessions.During the Red Devils' match against San Luis in the 14th round of the Clausura 2026 of Liga MX, it was confirmed that Ruiz will travel with the squad. This decision aims to strengthen his integration process with the group, although his return to the field might happen in the next game against América. Caution is key to avoid complications in his recovery.The interest of the Mexican National Team in Marcel Ruiz remains strong, and his potential inclusion in the roster for the 2026 World Cup keeps the player's hopes alive. Javier Aguirre, part of the Tri's coaching staff, has expressed his desire to see Ruiz in action, evaluating his performance and recovery. The priority is to avoid surgery that could complicate his career.The trip to Los Angeles is not only a step in his rehabilitation but also an opportunity for Ruiz to feel part of the team at a crucial moment. Although he is not expected to play, his presence is a morale booster for his teammates and a sign that his return is getting closer. Toluca's fans eagerly await to see him back on the field, bringing his talent and vision to the game.Marcel Ruiz's situation is a reminder of the importance of patience and care in sports. His recovery is a process that requires time, but his determination and the team's support are crucial. The Red Devils are confident that they will soon be able to count on him at full capacity, both in Liga MX and the Concacaf Champions Cup.TolucaMarcel RuizConcacaf Champions Cup
